interview:
I did not win. I played several rounds of "Le Chonk's Fish Heist" but lost every single one — the guard dog caught Le Chonk each time before I could reach the fish.

Here's what happened across my attempts:
- I started the game by typing "Chonk" and pressing Play.
- I tried moving straight up the left edge, but the dog intercepted me.
- I tried luring the dog along the bottom row, but it cut me off and caught me.
- I tried a few other routes, but the dog consistently stepped toward the cat and caught me before I reached the fish at the top-right.

In the final screenshot, the game was still in progress at Move 1 with the cat at the bottom-left, the dog nearby, and the fish still out of reach. I never managed to get Le Chonk to the fish, so I have no win to report — I lost every round I played.
